## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; market shows strong breadth but concentrated defensive leadership. Confirmations: Healthcare leadership with multiple ABOVE TREND names (ABBV, MRK, JNJ, LLY, DHR) and Technology mega-cap weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND); Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 are 5/5 Healthcare).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%). Real Estate strong: WELL ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +6.14%), VTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.13% | 1M: +1.14%); Industrials supportive: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.62%), HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.58%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%). Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%); Materials weak: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%). 5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%), NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%). Weakness concentrated in Technology and Materials names and select cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%), MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%), JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%), DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%), TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%); these are confirming moves (1W and 1M both positive). Divergences: only minor — mega-cap Tech uniformly BELOW TREND rather than short-term reversals, so no MAJOR divergence signal from megacaps.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak and fractured with large-cap selling: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%). Sector 1W: -3.49% (24 stocks) — look for follow-through or capitulation in megacaps before adding exposure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady with selective strength: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +2.63%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%). Sector 1W: +0.09% (20 stocks) — financials provide rotation alternative to weak Tech but breadth is mixed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is the clear leader: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%). Sector 1W: +7.10% (17 stocks) — bullish news flow and earnings/approvals driving confirmed accumulation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare leaders (ABBV, LLY, MRK, JNJ) and selective Industrials/Real Estate exposure (CAT, HD, WELL) while reducing exposure to concentrated Technology mega-cap risk. Style: Mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given narrow leadership and CAUTION regime.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%), IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%). BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +7.05%) — watch earnings/approval follow-through. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62%) — monitor mega-cap flows and any widening breadth deterioration.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance around prior range lows to monitor for further breakdown (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%)). ABBV support/new base to confirm continued run (ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%)). JPM momentum level for continuation above recent highs (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ABBV (+60): Health Canada approval headline; price confirming (ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%)) — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+80): EMA backing for Jaypirca; price confirming (LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%)). IBM (+60): chip/quantum product news; price confirming (IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%)).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-65): CFO departure/clinical miss headline; price confirming weakness (PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -7.33%)). AAPL (-45): downgrade headline; price confirming (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%)). META (-45): limits on Gemini access headline; price confirming (META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -13.30%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; Style: Mixed / no clear leadership given defensive Healthcare dominance and Tech weakness. Healthcare names ABBV, MRK, JNJ, LLY are showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap Technology (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) remain BELOW TREND. Key risk: narrow leadership and confirmed negative news in select Tech names — watch for distribution or trend breaks before re-engaging broader growth exposure.
